name: J. Neil Stuart
tagline: Top rated Business Litigation attorney in Phoenix, Arizona
education: University of San Francisco School of Law
about: After law school, served for two years as a Law Clerk to the Honorable Jennifer G. Zipps of the United States District Court, District of Arizona. Achieved the third highest score on the February 2011 Arizona bar examination. Prior to joining Cohen Dowd Quigley ("CDQ"), worked as a Deputy County Attorney with the Maricopa County Attorney’s Office where successfully prosecuted three jury trials and ten bench trials. Since joining CDQ in August 2014, work on complex commercial litigation, representing both plaintiffs and defendants in state court, federal court and arbitration. Became a partner at CDQ in 2022 and also serve as a Federal Bar Association board member (Phoenix chapter).
honors: Selected as a Southwest Rising Star in the area of Business Litigation. , 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 Southwest Rising Stars , Super Lawyers
Best Lawyers: Ones to Watch , Best Lawyers
During law school, participated in the National Moot Court Competition and was awarded American College of Trial Lawyers Medal for Excellence in Advocacy.
Acheived the third highest score on the February 2011 state bar exam.
